items.question: When round 1 returns only drafting defects, how does doc review end?
options: One corrective reviser version, lint and narrow check, then approve
Approve at once with the findings open
Carry the findings to the next phase

items.question: How many Next tiles does a shared store show?
options: One tile per enabled project (overrides dashboard-board D11)
Keep one tile per store with the warning only
Keep one tile and add a project picker

items.question: After the controller patches tasks.md, what re-runs?
What does close-out do with a recorded answer that no batch can build?
options: Infer a landing class from the answer text
Send it to the store batch

items.question: What is the top-level money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
items.basis: Checked all eleven items: no billing, payment, refund, credit or pricing code; no user accounts or personal data. The only deletion is Discard removing a git worktree, branch and PR of a dev run, which is not personal-data erasure. Project names and paths are operator tooling config.
